field.label: Name
field.help: Unique plugin instance name, referenced by peers. Letters, digits, dash and underscore only.

field.label: Type
field.help: builtin uses a plugin compiled into stunmesh-go (Cloudflare or OpenDHT). exec and shell run an external helper program.

field.label: Builtin plugin
field.help: Only used when Type is builtin.

field.label: OpenDHT endpoints
field.help: Comma separated list of OpenDHT proxy URLs. Only used for the opendht builtin plugin.

field.label: Cloudflare zone
field.help: DNS zone name. Only used for the cloudflare builtin plugin.

field.label: Cloudflare API token
field.help: Only used for the cloudflare builtin plugin.

field.label: Cloudflare subdomain
field.help: Only used for the cloudflare builtin plugin.

field.label: Command
field.help: Path to the external helper executable. Only used for the exec and shell plugin types.

field.label: Deduplicate
field.help: Enable stunmesh-go's dedup mode for this plugin instance.
